settings.hero_desc: A highly detailed scale model of a refinery - distillation columns, tanks, pipework and road tankers laid out to scale under a clear case. The clearest way to present a complex process plant to clients and investors.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your plant, labels, branding and case
settings.desc_title_em: You Can Take In at a Glance?
settings.s1_body: A process plant is dense and technical; a model makes it readable. We build refineries and petrochemical facilities to scale - towering columns, storage tanks, pipe racks and loading bays - so engineers, clients and investors grasp the layout and process instantly. Finished under a clear case, it's a commanding centrepiece for boardrooms, exhibitions and project pitches.
settings.case_heading: A Process You Can Point At
settings.case_body: Commissioned by KBF Trading as a VIP gift for their clients' factory inaugurations - every time they finish constructing an oil and gas factory for a client, this model is gifted to them as a symbol of partnership.
settings.case_quote: We gift this model every time a project is completed. We also made one extra model for our own sales presentation.
settings.case_quote_attr: Sandeep - Sales Manager at KBF Trading
settings.prov_p: The more technical the plant, the more a model helps. Seeing columns, tanks and pipework in 3D turns a complex explanation into instant understanding.
